name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response aligns with the given context and the interesting fact provided. A higher score indicates a strong connection to the prompt.

name: Creativity
description: Assesses the originality and uniqueness of the response. Responses that introduce novel ideas or perspectives receive higher scores.

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical flow and clarity of the response. A coherent response should make sense and be easy to follow.

name: Engagement
description: Measures the ability of the response to capture interest and provoke further conversation. Higher scores indicate a more engaging continuation.

name: Empathy
description: Assesses the level of understanding and consideration of the conversational partner's perspective. Responses that show awareness of emotions and context score higher.
